title: Mixed Event — At This Festival Bathed in Twilight — Episode6 Shining While On Stage

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight
meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu continues to study for her medical school entrance exams while developing some angst towards her mother. However, she ends up volunteering for a big festival called Shibuya Festa and...

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, talk about a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to see you around the stalls, Rui, since I thought you and your troupe would be getting ready for your show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're currently going through the performances by elementary schools, so it's a bit crowded backstage. We'll head over a little later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show's this evening, so you should come watch! We've prepared something that's going to be perfect for this place at that time of day!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Akiyama, are these your friends...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
This is Kanade and Ena! We're all in the same music group!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... I'm Ena Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're Kamishiro, right? And Kusanagi? We met when we got lost on that mountain. Thank you for saving us that time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really didn't do much at all, so there's no need to thank us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right... It was nothing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
You guys all know each other?!
What a coincidence♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, it's been a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you know her too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
She taught me how to draw♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui's my friend from junior high, Kanade. He's also the one who gave us those tickets to PXL.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uhh... It's nice to meet you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting Phoenix Wonderland the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had no idea that Rui's the person you're always mentioning, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's right. And everyone here is a member of the cast at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm Emu Otori! It's nice to meet you! You can call me Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Nice to meet you. I'm Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's nice to meet you as well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And I am Tsukasa Tenma, future star!
Remember my name!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-So loud...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm...?
This delivery... Where have I heard it before...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, you're being way too loud!
Kanade, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um, yes.
I suppose a show actor should be able to project their voice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I really enjoyed the show we saw at PXL that time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
We'll be performing later this evening, so I hope you get a chance to see our show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade and Rui are talking to each other! I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I really wish you guys could've also met Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Who's Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We have one more person in our group, but she can't meet up until later this evening.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll be able to meet up in time for your show, but I kinda wanted to introduce you guys to her...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh...
Are you talking about Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Wait, Emu, you and Mafuyu go to the same school, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But... She seemed kinda down when she came to see the night show that time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope she gets to enjoy the festival......

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for showing so much concern for her, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, when Mizuki and the others visited that other time...)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it looks like we're going to have another good-sized crowd again today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki and the others will also be here, so we'll need to put on a better performance than... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all for being so patient!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please sit back and enjoy today's performance by Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, that girl's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, she's so acrobatic...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nice work.
Um, Emu, is it just me or were you more motivated than usual today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, your acrobatics were a sight to behold...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But you seem a bit preoccupied.
Is there anything on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing is, this older girl I know at school came to see our show today, but she doesn't seem very happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I started trying really hard because I really wanted her to smile...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From school? Oh, is that who you were looking at before our show started...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! That's probably her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's really nice of you, Emu.
I'm not entirely sure what's going on, but I hope this person ends up feeling better as a result.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So the person Emu was trying to cheer up that time was Mizuki's friend, Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, something not so pleasant happened to Mafuyu that day and really wasn't feeling good...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But she seems a little better now, so there's no need for you to worry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right!
I bet she's gonna feel even better after seeing you guys' show today, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Then, I'm gonna try my best to make Asahina smile today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Emu seems much better now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and it's good to hear that her senior is also feeling better!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still don't have all the details, but for Emu and this other person's sake, I'd like to do what I can during today's show...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait! It's almost time for Saki and her band to play! We need to head over now to find some good seats!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you guys about to head over to the stage?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, let's all go together!
We were also just about to go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! We're heading to the same place!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let us go see Saki and her band play!
Shibuya Festa - Stage Area

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa! There's a huge crowd here!
This is awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's like a sea of people...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm guessing everyone walking around outside the stage area can also probably see what's going on. How do you feel? Nervous?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're nervous?
But you've definitely sung in front of more people by the Scramble Crossing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I, uh... I was just a little surprised!
But I should be able to sing just fine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I know it's gonna be your first time singing at an outdoor venue, Kohane, but let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Over there... Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Mizuki!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, An! Li'l Bro and company too!
Are you guys also here to see the show?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's always important to see the kinds of performances everyone else is doing. Also, the people behind you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, if isn't all of you!
What a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
A-Akito?!
I thought you guys didn't take the stage until way later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, the Puyo Puyo pro's here too!
Hello!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not a pro, but it's nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're all here quite early, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we still have some time on our hands, but we came early to see Azusawa's friends and Saki since we knew they'd be performing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...!
That means you're all here to cheer for Saki!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, we're not here to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all see them play together? This area should fit us all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds great!
I think I'll take a seat here too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't mind either, but... How about you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um. That shouldn't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's nice to see a show with such a big group for a change, isn't it, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Yeah, I guess so... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm seeing Momoi and her friends over that way. It looks like they're disguising themselves to blend in.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess being famous has its costs.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I can't wait to see Saki and her band perform! I really don't get enough chances to since our shows always seem to conflict with theirs...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Ichika said that Saki came up with a really amazing song the other day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, is that so...?
Then, I'll be looking forward to hearing it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to hearing Hoshino sing. Especially since I haven't really heard her sing during a show yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, Kanade, your friend's band must be pretty famous! I'm getting all excited now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I can't wait to hear them play.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know it's a shame that Mafuyu isn't here with us... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, isn't that...?!
Mafuyu, over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mafuyu!
It's me♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So this is where you've been!
Oh, does volunteering mean you get to work on stage?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I'm working with Information, and this is where I've been assigned.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's still really lucky!
We're all sitting just over there, so technically you'll be able to watch the show with us, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As much as it'd be nice to see the show, I have work to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Plus, our group's pretty huge right now. That might prevent Mafuyu from just relaxing and being herself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you again once you're finished volunteering!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Akiyama seems to be waving to someone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
A-Asahina?! She's here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, so it is her...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
Can you tell me where the restrooms are?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, they're straight down this path...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something the matter, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahina doesn't seem very happy today either...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She seems more or less normal to me...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Emu has a way of knowing how others feel, so there may be something going on that I'm not seeing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And figuring out how someone else feels is no simple matter.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even understanding how oneself feels can be difficult. It wouldn't be good to intrude or overstep my bounds...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, the show's about to start!!
Saki!! You can do it!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Most of you are probably seeing us for the first time, so we're hoping that our show helps you remember who we are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We actually did our very first show as a band at an outdoor venue like this one. We all felt really nervous that time and I even had a little trouble singing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But that experience led us to our current goal... To become professional musicians.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since then, we've been writing our own songs with original lyrics. We've had our share of successes and failures...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we want to play in a way that really moves people's hearts. We want to do that more than anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've poured everything we have into each of our songs, so I hope you enjoy them! And please enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa! They're so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hoshino's gotten so much better...
I'm probably gonna need to start asking her for lessons.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So much power!
They must've been practicing a ton! It's clear just by the way they're singing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Their bassist is also really good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and their rhythm section's in perfect sync. Also, their songs have this way of reaching into your heart.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can totally tell why you really like them, Kanade! It's like they're exuding cuteness and coolness at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hoshino's singing voice is so pretty and has so much power... But her band is also playing incredibly as a whole.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki and the others must've practiced quite a lot until this point...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Play in a way that moves people's hearts...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd heard that Saki's band was trying to go pro, but this is completely beyond what I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami, you're so cool!
And wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're doing great, Saki! Keep it up, Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but again, we're nowhere near that level yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that we'll be able to write and play those kinds of songs someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want us to be that kind of band.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Again, my chest...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What is this feeling...?
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone!
That was a super amazing show!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and we got a good response from the crowd...! I think we were able to make full use of everything we learned during our training sessions.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though we were playing at an outdoor venue, Ichika, your voice seemed to reach pretty far. It looked like even the people way in the back could hear you well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was great to see everyone having so much fun! Thanks for suggesting that we perform at Shibuya Festa, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
That band was really good.
What was their name again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Oh, the flyer I got from them should say. Leo/need. I remember them saying that they usually perform at live houses.

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Really?
It might be fun to go hear them play sometime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Our flyer helped them remember our band name!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's incredible...!
Thank you for making them, Honami, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...!
I couldn't be happier...!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Hang on. What's this thing? A sea urchin?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Huh? I thought it was a scrubbing brush.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
I guess it really doesn't look like a lion...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry too much about that. The important thing is that they remember who we are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
We can keep trying different ideas regarding that while doing our best to have more people listen to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So let's keep up the good work!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
